Uncertain readings are marked [?]: "rupi" (line 1), "charact[?]er" (the word reads as "character" but is faint), "socium", "vitio", "quo se", "ad" (in "ad necem", the printed form may be "qd"), "perseverarunt", "cessarânt". The catchword "usque" is alone at the right below the last full line, so it is kept there and not repeated in the text. The "usque" entered as a foot paragraph is the catchword and should be removed from the running text if the script treats it as furniture. The "Matth. 11:19. 9:11." and "Joh. 8:40." references are inside the text in italic and are not marginal notes. No marginal notes are printed on this page. The small mark at the lower right is a printer's ornament and is not transcribed.
